method: Run the executable release-contract bank, repair general contracts rather than assertions, add adversarial variants, and rerun the whole bank.

failures: Feasible overlapping quotas failed under first-match assignment.
Infeasibility did not expose structured deficits.
Catalog plans were not bound to final evaluation, validation, source membership, or master identity.
Receipt artifact drift did not block state or later phases.

iterations.new_pressure: Mixed identities, stale validation, plan tampering, missing artifacts, event caps, and 4,000-item production shape
failures: Partially missing evaluation identity was accepted.
Validation did not reject a stale evaluation identity.
iterations.performance_observation: The production-shaped test passed but unit-at-a-time minimum-cost flow made the ordinary eval loop too slow.

iterations.new_pressure: The 4,000-item case was strengthened from dedicated rows to overlapping cross-view candidates.
changes: Complete evaluation identity required whenever identity is present.
Validation binds the final evaluation to the frozen master.
Deterministic evidence-ranked capacity max-flow replaces unit-at-a-time minimum-cost flow.

iterations.new_pressure: Exact evaluation and validation report digests plus semantically rehashed release-plan tampering
changes: Catalog plans retain the exact evaluation and validation report SHA-256 digests.
The bridge independently checks plan semantics, counts, master membership, and every release identity after content-hash verification.
iterations.stop_reason: The expanded deterministic bank passed without weakening assertions, the paired agent bank reached 12/12, and the production-shaped case remained fast enough for every check run.
